QuestInfo.name: Guwaru from Beyond
QuestInfo.2: Guwaru appeared before you, but it seemed different somehow.

0.0: So, it is you. How many centuries has it been?\r\n#L0##bGuwaru! Villain!#l\n#k
0.1: Yes, it is I: Guwaru the Great Spirit.\r\n#L0##bI thought Magnus killed you!#l\n#k
0.2: I cannot be killed. I am part of this world.\r\n#L0##bI did not come here to talk. Where is the Black Mage!#l\n#k
0.3: I do not know. The Black Mage is no longer my concern.\r\n#L0##bAre you not one of his Commanders?#l\n#k
0.4: When Magnus destroyed my body, he severed the Black Mage's hold on my mind. I have no desire to return to his side.

yes.0: In many ways, I am the Guwaru you met on the battlefield. But in many ways, I am not.

no.0: Like many of your species, you are too slow to trust.
